$comment: One template for every repo's GitHub Project, from docs/project-boards.md (ADR 0024). groupBy, sortBy and columnBy are set by hand in the UI (the API cannot set them) and read back by check. The board's columns are the Stage issue field. Status is aligned with Stage both ways by the reconciler (issue 78); no script writes it on items. Priority is the org number field 1-100 (100 = do first).

views.name: Needs me
views.manual: Group by Stage. Sort by Priority descending (100 first).

views.name: Flow
views.manual: Column field: Stage (test T8: drag a card and check the issue's Stage changed). Sort by Priority descending. No column limit: GitHub refuses one on an issue-field column (T11, 2026-11-11). Add the Type column by hand if the UI offers it: the API exposes no Type field, so check does not verify it.

views.name: Epics
views.manual: Group by Milestone. Sort by Priority descending.

views.name: Shipped
views.manual: Sort by Updated, newest first. Add the Type column by hand if the UI offers it: the API exposes no Type field, so check does not verify it.

workflows: Set these after build: build replaces the Status options, and a workflow set before it shows a red ! until edited to a valid value.
Item added to project → Status: OFF (through the reconciler it would overwrite Stage)

Auto-add to project: OFF on the template (no linked repo, and copies do not inherit it); ON in each repo project, filter is:issue is:open, as a stopgap until the periodic job (issue 78) adds missing issues
Item reopened, Pull request linked to issue, Pull request merged, Code changes requested, Code review approved (OFF)
access: Settings → Manage access: visibility private to the org, base role Write for members. Ready is guarded by the auto-start allowlist (issue 76), not by the project's permissions.
